name: Velocipes
isnote: Originally called a coelurosaur; later work considers it a basal theropod or dinosauriform (Skawiński et al. 2017).
sum: Poorly known Late Triassic saurischian from Poland that may be a basal theropod.
holotype: Not given in the sources used.
material: Not given in the sources used (a fibula is figured on Commons).
biology: Not given in the sources used.
